ablation.name: local_t13_ll_global_style_inject
ablation.notes: T13: LL Global Statistics Injection (LLGSI) — 打破 1:8 trade-off. 理论: cross-attention输出空间变化→用于LL扰动结构(LPIPS暴涨). LLGSI对LL用style_mem池化统计量做AdaIN(空间均匀)→注入全局色调不扰动空间结构. CLIP-S看全局色调(LL统计), LPIPS看空间结构(LL空间分布), AdaIN仅移动mean/std不改变空间分布→双超可能. 基于4J.1(dwt_route=true), 添加ll_global_style_inject=true, gate_init=0.1.
